MicrosoftStore.executionRule: During remaining PC windows, hard paid publication debt outranks starting another app build. Cloud-side Store research/build prep may continue without displacing paid recovery.

GitHubPages.rule: Do not prioritize a new free tool while note/BOOTH hard publication floors remain unsatisfied unless every paid candidate is globally blocked. Existing pending meeting-action may be verified without consuming paid build capacity.

rules: Previous-day debt is serviced before current-day quota is considered satisfied.
Maintain more qualified candidates than remaining hard minimum.
At each remaining PC window, stale legacy items receive only a brief strict retry before failover.
Queue insertion, local success, admin/editor URLs and commits do not count as publication.
Do not publish near-duplicate low-value products merely to satisfy count; use distinct qualified reserves.
Do not require Windows execution after 01:00 JST; residual shortfall becomes debt and is never zero-cleared.
Do not label a product or cluster a winner without observed performance evidence.
